sampling_audit.coverage_definition:
Fraction of source GT voxel centers inside the augmented patch support.

    Uses the inverse actual affine, and intersects with the initial crop support.
    Not post-augmentation voxel count divided by native volume (scaling biases that).
    Excludes interpolation/threshold effects; denominator is full preprocessed GT.
sampling_audit.decision: review_required: assess substantive lesion exposure increase, especially 1–5 mL; equality alone is NOT a decision criterion
sampling_audit.caveat: Same initial seed does not pair subsequent cases when different cropping branches consume different random draws. Diagnostic is synchronous; full training uses seeded nondeterministic workers. Native GT defines subgroups; coverage denominator is preprocessed GT.

limitations: Fold 0 only; single seed screening; same-seed is not fully deterministic. The 100-epoch checkpoint is an early screening state using the first 100 epochs of the 1000-epoch PolyLR trajectory, not a final model. Bootstrap CIs describe case-level uncertainty in this validation cohort.
